items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: I called Doctor Newman the next day and he told me to bring Zutty in.

ctx.x: You see your personal physician and they said, but we have a bed for him, I said, I'm not going to leave him here. He doesn't want to stay here and I don't want him to stay. And God had his arms around us because we had to walk so far to get in a cab to come home and he had told me to keep him on a salt free diet. I forgot all about that and he gave me get him a prescription. And I rushed right to the drug store and had the prescription filled. And said, call your doctor tomorrow.
